newsitem.title: USA: Maytag to distribute European commercial washing machines.
newsitem.headline: Maytag to distribute European commercial washing machines.

text.p: Maytag Corp. said Tuesday it has agreed to distribute European-made multi-load commercial washing machines in North America to bolster its commercial laundry business.

Under the agreement, Primus, a Belgian company, will supply Maytag with its line of oversized front-loading commercial washing machines. The machines will be sold in the United States and Canada under the Maytag brand name.

The Primus machines are designed for use in hospitals, hotels, nursing homes, athletic clubs, and other facilities where large volumes of laundry are done on premise, as well as in coin-operated laundreys, Maytag said.
"This should strengthen and improve our business in the coin operated laundry market and will open up a whole new market for Maytag in on-premise laundry," the company said.
The introduction of a Maytag brand horizontal-axis high-efficiency washing machine this year also promises growth for the commercial business, it added.
Maytag, based in Newton, Iowa, makes home appliances for laundry, cooking, dishwashing, refrigeration and floor care.
Maytag's stock rose 25 cents to $21.75 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
